authorization_scope: New agent-assistance cohort only; previous allowances are not reused.

development_agents.treatment_arm: ordinary investigation plus one source-inspection packet
development_agents.context: No inherited chat; target/demand/public acceptance only, then the same frozen common attempt and feedback.

paid_dispatch_gate: Review and full Windows/Linux CI plus explicit new-cohort authorization.
packet_policy: First returned match in existing model output order; no manual preferred mechanism selection. Existing inspection handoff may be partial/unqualified. Provide source identity, selected capability and cited source excerpts, existing contribution, assumptions and limits; omit generated target bridge code. Maximum 16000 UTF-8 bytes, explicit omissions. Stop rather than silently corrupt or truncate evidence.
